db.ssh_hint: The host above must be reachable from the SSH machine. The tunnel uses the ssh program of the system. Leave the local port empty to let the system choose.
db.ssl_hint: PEM files. verify-ca checks the certificate comes from the CA, verify-full also checks the host name. Without a CA file, the system's authorities are used.
db.schema_pattern_hint: database:schema,schema entries separated by |. * is all, @ is the current one. Examples: @:* (default), *:public, shop:public,sales.
db.object_filter_hint: type:regex entries separated by |; a - before the regex hides what matches. Types: table, view, mview, ftable. Example: table:-audit_.*
db.props_hint: Passed to the connection as is: application_name, connect_timeout, options, target_session_attrs…
db.driver_file_hint: A driver file of your own, used in place of the downloaded one.
db.where_hint: condition, for example price > 10 AND name LIKE 'a%'
db.read_only_table: Read-only: not a table, or the session is read-only.
db.pending_block: Commit or revert the pending changes first.

db.not_nullable: This column does not accept NULL.
db.row_revert: Revert the changes of the row
db.log_empty: No command run yet. Every SQL command sent to a database is listed here.

db.console_no_connection: Add a data source first: the queries run on one.

db.console_busy_running: A query is running: wait for it, or stop it, before changing the data source.

db.preview_hint: All of it in one transaction, in this order.
db.keyless_table: No primary key: a row is found by its place and its values.
db.confirm_drop_text: This removes the %{kind} and everything in it. It cannot be undone.
db.confirm_empty_text: Every row is removed; the table stays. It cannot be undone.
db.confirm_cascade: Also drop what depends on it (CASCADE)
db.dsql_hint: Run in one transaction, in this order: all or nothing.
db.dp_needs_columns: A key, constraint or index needs its columns.
db.dp_needs_reference: A foreign key needs the table it points to.
db.dp_sqlite_limit: This change needs the table to be made again, which SQLite cannot do with ALTER: only adding, renaming and dropping columns, indexes and the name of the table can be done here.
db.dp_several_keys: A table has only one primary key.
db.dcol_order_note: PostgreSQL cannot move a column: new columns are added at the end. To change the order, create a new table and copy the data.
db.dp_no_columns: A table needs at least one column.
db.opt_timeout_hint: A statement that runs longer is stopped by the server. Empty: no limit; the Stop button of the console stops a query at any time.
